description:
Activate the creature with Bigger on the Inside and Freed from the Real attached by tapping it, adding {U}{U} and causing the next spell you cast this turn to have cascade.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

uses.name: Bigger on the Inside
uses.cardState: attached to an artifact creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

uses.name: Freed from the Real
uses.cardState: attached to the same creature that has Bigger on the Inside attached
